notes.title: Update Version 0.10.0b
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to announce our debut on Steam after a long and passionate development journey. Although there is still some way to go before the final launch, each step fills us with enthusiasm and the desire to share it with all of you. This new phase will undoubtedly bring interesting challenges, but we are prepared to face them and learn from the experience.

In this update, we have focused on fixing some critical bugs and enhancing various aspects of the game to enrich your gaming experience. Here are the details:

[h2]
[b]Improvements and Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now skip long dialogues in level 3, allowing you to quickly move on to the next phase without unnecessary waits.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixed Issues:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The Signal Inhibitor shields in level 3 now function correctly, preventing the game from freezing when specific enemies spawn.
[*] The game's title text at the end of level 1 is now properly centered on the screen.
[*] The visual trail left by certain projectiles, which previously covered a large portion of the screen upon disappearing, has been adjusted.
[*] Fixed the improper activation of a particle system when selecting a weapon in the customization menu.
[*] Action icons now display correctly when playing with the PlayStation DualSense controller.
[*] 3D objects in level 3 now receive proper lighting.
[/list]

[h2][b]New Additions:
[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] New types of enemy projectiles with unique behaviors have been introduced, adding more dynamism to the combat.
[*] New attack patterns to challenge you with multiple shots simultaneously.
[*] Incorporation of new PowerUps to enhance your in-game capabilities.
[/list]
[u][b]
Currently, this version is available exclusively to a select group of players. If you wish to join this exciting trial phase, let us know![/b][/u]

Thank you so much for your continued support, and we look forward to your feedback!
